title: Groundwork canvas status.json
description: Agent -> rail. The decision-engine status the rail renders (decide panel + convergence meter). Written by the agent to <dir>/.canvas/status.json; served verbatim at GET /__canvas/status. Forward-compatible: unknown fields MUST be ignored by shells.

schema.description: Optional in v1; absence MEANS v1. Additive per PROTOCOL.md §versioning.

info_gain.description: Max remaining uncertainty*importance across eligible dims.

ready.description: STOP asking when true; rail shows the converged banner and suppresses the question.

next_question.description: Dimension to ask next, or null when exhausted.

ranked.description: Top dims by info gain, [dim, score] pairs, high first.

goal.description: The VALUES answer, in the user's words.

fork.description: OPTIONAL. Present when next_question is a genuine pairwise fork; renders the A/B on the canvas. A click POSTs {kind:'decide', dim:fork.dim, value:'a'|'b'}.

dim.description: REQUIRED — echoed back in the decide feedback row.

question.description: Optional; rail falls back to 'Which direction?'

ioAnnotations.description: OPTIONAL. Map of data-component name -> its data contract, rendered as a display-only io-chip on the matching [data-component] element (PROTOCOL.md §5a). Non-destructive: absence renders zero chips, same as pre-feature DOM. Inline data-datain/data-dataout attributes on the element take precedence over this map when both are present.

decisionMeta.description: OPTIONAL display-only decision badges keyed by decision or dimension. Does not alter feedback payloads or decision-engine calls.

ioAnnotation.description: Mirrors the Spec's ScreenElement.dataIn.source / dataOut for one component, in the rail's chip text.

preview.description: OPTIONAL. Absent = no live preview (pre-existing behavior, unchanged). Present -> hovering/focusing this option in the rail POSTs {component,addClass,removeClass} to /__canvas/preview, which the server relays as an SSE 'preview' frame; the rail toggles the class(es) on the matching [data-component] element in the iframe until mouseleave/blur (or a real canvas reload) reverts it. Purely visual — never written to disk.

component.description: Matches a [data-component="<name>"] element already rendered in the canvas.

addClass.description: CSS class to add on the previewed element while hovered/focused.

removeClass.description: CSS class to remove on the previewed element while hovered/focused.
